fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) carry explicit fields extracted from the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap) carry title/link-style fields from the Google News sitemap.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text from the NewsArticle JSON-LD's articleBody field (HTML-unescaped, article-mode).

author.title: Author
author.description: Comma-joined byline name(s), flattened from the JSON-LD author list/dict (article-mode).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords -- comma-separated string (article-mode) or a list split from news:keywords (latest-mode).

image.title: Image URL
image.description: Lead image URL, flattened from the JSON-LD image object (article-mode).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the Google News sitemap (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
